rationale: The agent did perform user lookup and accessed the correct user/order, but there is no evidence of obtaining explicit user confirmation before executing an order-changing write, which the policy requires. Only one exchange operation was executed despite the user's initial request to exchange two items (water bottle and desk lamp), unless the agent asked for confirmation—yet no confirmation step is shown. Therefore, the action appears incomplete and not in full compliance with the confirmation requirement. Without clear confirmation and with only a single item exchanged, the interaction fails the pass bar.
